shared_elements: low-relief carving with figures in profile
animal/creature in profile with head turned to side
human or humanoid figure with arms shown
horizontal band-like registers dividing the surface
justification: Both are low-relief surfaces organised into registers with profile figures and some hatched/linear patterning, but the actual content differs almost entirely: A shows schematic animals (quadruped, birds, a snake-like or feathered form) and small abstracted anthropomorphs stacked in zones, while B shows a naturalistic banquet-type scene with a seated bearded figure raising a cup on a chair, attended by a standing figure with a staff. The rendering conventions are also opposed — A's stiff, outline-only, hieroglyph-like creatures versus B's detailed drapery, coiffure and furniture — so the correspondences are of the most generic kind.
